register.logical_color: four independent RGB channels with byte serialization in red-blue-green order
register.physical_caveat: 96 bits are four logical 24-bit registers, not a claim of 96-bit optical wavelength depth

coupling.ingress_hydrogen: increments red channel by 48 on leg's bank, saturating at 255
coupling.ingress_nitrogen: increments blue channel by 48 on leg's bank, saturating at 255
coupling.oxygen_egress: increments green channel by 32 on associated bank, saturating at 255
coupling.routing: v0.8 router unchanged aside from deterministic ingress/egress event publication

browser.expected_saturated_payload: FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF

next: v0.10 use four RBG banks to gate optical phase/intensity in a calibrated non-color-only model; test stability and conservation.
